stories.title: Montreal sputters late, loses Grey Cup again
stories.summary: The Montreal Alouettes' potent offence sputtered in the fourth quarter and the team went home from the Grey Cup empty-handed a second straight year.

stories.title: Draisaitl scores twice, McDavid ties Gretzky’s fastest-to-40-assists in the Oilers’ 5-2 win
stories.summary: The Edmonton Oilers have now won five straight and lead the NHL with 35 points.

stories.title: Philpot named Grey Cup’s top Canadian in defeat
stories.summary: There was no consolation for Tyson Philpot after he was named the Grey Cup's most valuable Canadian in a losing cause Sunday night.

stories.title: Edmonton Elks win the Grey Cup, defeat Montreal Alouettes by 37-30
stories.summary: The win follows a decade-long journey to revive the Edmonton team, which went six seasons of not making the playoffs and had a drop in attendance amid a 22-game home losing streak.

stories.title: Snowbirds take final Tutor jet flight over Grey Cup: ‘It’s been an honour’
stories.summary: 'Thank you for sharing this historic moment with us,' Snowbird 1 pilot Major Maciej Hatta said as the troupe soared the sunset skies over Calgary's McMahon Stadium.

stories.title: Russia won’t be able to compete in World Juniors, IIHF says
stories.summary: Russia's hockey federation is calling the decision by the IIHF is "unlawful" and plans to appeal the decision to the International Olympic Committee.

stories.title: Maas, Kilam to take time with roster decisions
stories.summary: Head coaches Jason Maas and Mark Kilam are going to go as long as they can before finalizing their Grey Cup rosters.

stories.title: Edmonton clinic launches Alberta’s first self-referral insulin pump program
stories.summary: The Edmonton Diabetes and High Risk Foot Clinic is the first in Alberta to allow patients with Type 1 diabetes to refer themselves without going through a family doctor.

stories.title: Alouettes, Elks clash in a battle of divisional powers at 113th Grey Cup game
stories.summary: The 113th Grey Cup game Sunday at McMahon Stadium in Calgary will be a battle of divisional leaders and winners.

stories.title: Leafs finish ugly homestand with another loss
stories.summary: Anthony Stolarz watched from the crease as his teammates battled for 60 hard minutes.
